steps.instruction: Park both cars face to face and turn them off.
steps.done_looks_like: Red hood raised open over the front engine bay with the engine off.

checks.text: The hood is fully raised and the engine is off

common_mistakes: Hood only unlatched but not lifted open

steps.instruction: Open both hoods and locate the batteries.
steps.done_looks_like: Black hood raised open with the black battery exposed in the engine bay.

checks.text: A black battery is present in the open engine bay
The hood is fully raised and held open

common_mistakes: Hood propped but battery cover not visible

steps.instruction: Attach both red clamps to the positive terminals.
steps.done_looks_like: Red clamp gripping the positive terminal on the black battery in the engine bay.

checks.text: The red cable clamp is on the positive terminal of the black battery
Red clamp gripping the positive terminal on the black battery in the engine bay.

common_mistakes: Clamp touching but not gripping terminal

steps.instruction: Attach the black clamps to negative and ground.
steps.done_looks_like: Black clamp gripping bare metal ground in the engine bay.

checks.text: The black cable clamp is on bare metal ground in the engine bay
Black clamp gripping bare metal ground in the engine bay.

common_mistakes: Black clamp on painted surface instead of bare metal

steps.instruction: Start the working car and charge for a few minutes.
steps.done_looks_like: Hand turning the key in the ignition with dashboard lights lit.

checks.text: The key is turned and dashboard lights are on with engine running

common_mistakes: Key turned but engine not started
Starting disabled car instead of working car

steps.instruction: Start the disabled car, remove cables and let it run.
steps.done_looks_like: Engine bays with jumper clamps removed and cables clear of batteries.

checks.text: All jumper clamps are detached from both batteries
The disabled car key is turned and its engine runs on its own

common_mistakes: Cables removed in wrong order touching together
Disabled car stalled after cables removed
